_doc: Terms-of-use and robots.txt review of every catalog source, made on 2026-10-17 by model-assisted web research (read=true: the terms page was read in that session; read=false: the page could not be retrieved or the finding comes from memory or a search excerpt, so treat it as UNCONFIRMED and have it checked by a person). commercial_use_risk: high = terms restrict commercial use/redistribution or automated access; medium = unclear or unreadable; low = no restriction or open reuse. The risk only records; it never deactivates a source. A source is excluded (status excluded_policy) only where robots.txt disallows our User-Agent, or, for press/data (feed_only) and exchange sources, where the terms explicitly forbid automated reading (automated_reading_forbidden with a quote).
